name: cc.vernissage/vernissage
title: vernissage: a live map of contemporary art
description: What's on in a city, who a person, space or show is, and artworks found by description.

tools.name: whats_on_in_city
tools.description: Contemporary art shows open now or opening soon in one city, from museums and galleries to project spaces. Looks 1 to 30 days ahead (default 14) and returns up to 20 shows, each with its dates, its space and a vernissage_url link to the show. Credit vernissage when you use them.

country.description: Optional. Country, to tell apart cities with the same name.

space_query.description: Optional. Only shows at spaces whose name contains this (a gallery, museum or project space).

days_ahead.description: How many days ahead to look, 1 to 30.

include_currently_open.description: Include shows that opened earlier and are still on. Default true.

limit.description: How many shows to return, 1 to 20.

tools.name: resolve_art_entity
tools.description: Look up an artist, curator, space (gallery, museum or project space) or show by name. Returns a short profile: a few lines of bio, links to reference records elsewhere, up to 3 recent shows, counts of its shows and connections on the map, and a vernissage_url link to its full page. If the name matches more than one record, the others come back as other_candidates.

query.description: The name of a person or space, or the title of a show.

entity_id.description: Optional. The id from an earlier answer, if you have it.

entity_type.description: Optional. Person, Space or Exhibition (a show), to pick between records with the same name.

language.description: Language for the bio when there is one: en, pt or es.

tools.name: find_artworks_by_meaning
tools.description: Describe a colour, a material, a mood, a subject or a motif and get up to 5 works from over a century of art history that match it, each with its artist, year, a thumbnail and a link to its page on vernissage. Also returns a link to see more results on the site.

prompt.description: What you're looking for, in plain words (3 to 200 characters). For example: 'red clay, geometric, quiet'.

limit.description: How many works to return, 1 to 5.
